rationale: Chronological separation is fixed before joining race outcomes/payouts to reduce adaptive leakage.
rules: DEV may be used for feature construction and exploratory analysis.
VALIDATION is used only after candidate rules/models are frozen for that evaluation cycle.
OOS_LOCKED must not be joined/opened for confirmatory evaluation without explicit user approval tied to a preregistered trial_id.
No period boundary may be moved after observing outcome/ROI results; a change requires a new preregistration/version.
2026-08-22 and 2026-08-23 are outside this v1 dataset and must not be silently appended to an existing locked OOS evaluation.
